scope: Parent review of agent-authored transport ownership and retention barrier; not a simulator release review
author_role: The parent authored the original prototype and outer retention path. It did not author these transport/barrier fixes. Outer runtime and relay review is separate in native-worker-independent-338.md.
checks: A failed connected/character request consumes and closes the owned descriptor; no next request can consume a late reply.
PrivateTransport delegates to the same owned connected implementation.
Result collection verifies exact bytes, bounds, trace consistency and fsync before external retention callback.
Cleanup follows exact matching locked hash, token, run ID and result identity; the receipt is synchronized first.
Persisted external-retention requirement prevents default recovery from bypassing an incomplete barrier. Both cleaned recovery branches invoke a supplied barrier.
Real-worker tests preserve failures, require a fresh channel after loss, and verify retained bytes before cleanup.
